name: QOVA

seeds: small shops paid from far away
niche.community: people in Africa, Latin America and Southeast Asia who want USDC instead of weak local money, plus anyone paid from far away
where_they_gather: Telegram groups in Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Argentina, Brazil, the Philippines, Indonesia

concept.one_liner: Dollars for everyone, one link away.
concept.twist: a memecoin with a real free tool: non custodial USDC pay links on Solana. The coin is the meme, the link is the utility, and the link works without the coin.

engine.lane: C (tool for people, not traders) + real payments
engine.pitch: Make a link, anyone pays it from any Solana wallet, you get the exact amount in USDC.

loop.first_10_seconds: type your address and an amount, get a link and a QR
loop.first_day: send it to a client or family member, see it paid
loop.week_4: link history, first links map, community firsts

architecture.onchain: Solana Pay transfer request: USDC SPL transfer from payer wallet to receiver wallet, with a reference key
architecture.server: none in the foundation; later a read only payment check by reference via RPC

engine.mvp: pay link maker + pay page with QR and wallet deep link
engine.v2: payment confirmation by reference, link history, card on ramp (researched separately)
engine.moonshot: pay by card or Apple Pay, receiver gets USDC
abuse_cases: impersonation pay links (mitigation: pay page shows full address and a warning, never promises who owns it)
phishing clones (mitigation: anti scam line, official links only on site and pinned X)
risks: payments rules differ by country: check local rules
users confusing $QOVA with a stable dollar: clear copy near the top

mascot.description: a heavy polished chrome coin shaped like the letter Q; the circle is the coin, the tail is the link
mascot.medium: clean 3D render, CSS and SVG on the site
mascot.anatomy_twist: the tail stretches to whoever needs paying
mascot.signature_behaviour: tilts toward the cursor, flips when a link is made, glows mint when money lands

world: daylight fintech console with a halftone dot globe; one dark band holds the real tool

lore.origin: every coin in history carried a face; Qova was struck with no face, just a circle and a tail that points to whoever needs it next
open_threads: a coin with a face that wants to become Qova

disclaimer: $QOVA is a memecoin with no intrinsic value and no expectation of profit. It is not a dollar or a stablecoin and its price can go to zero. QOVA pay links are a free, non custodial demo: payments go straight between wallets and QOVA never holds, moves or converts money. USDC is issued by Circle, not by QOVA. Check the rules where you live. Not financial advice.
